related_questions.question: What is the long post COVID vaccine syndrome?

text_blocks.snippet: Long post-COVID vaccination syndrome (LPCVS) refers to persistent side effects lasting longer than four weeks after SARS-CoV-2 vaccination. Symptoms are diverse and can include visual disturbances, myalgia, muscle cramps, fatigue, syncope, fever, headache, and palpitations. LPCVS can occur at any age, in both sexes, and with any vaccine brand.
snippet_highlighted_words: persistent side effects lasting longer than four weeks after SARS-CoV-2 vaccination

list.snippet: Definition: LPCVS is characterized by side effects that persist for more than four weeks following COVID-19 vaccination.
Symptom Variability: Symptoms are highly variable and may or may not be accompanied by abnormal findings on medical tests.
Age and Sex: LPCVS can affect individuals of any age and either sex.
Vaccine Type: The syndrome can occur after any brand of SARS-CoV-2 vaccine.

Examples of Symptoms: A study published by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) lists some common symptoms: visual disturbances, muscle pain (myalgia) and cramping, fatigue, fainting (syncope), fever, headache, and heart palpitations (palpitations).
